purpose: Teach: カルシウム/材質/耕作/司教/旧約/起立/見識/人身

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、骨粗鬆症のカルシウム代謝研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered calcium metabolism in osteoporosis for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational acknowledgment. Slight upward lift at the end — genuine question despite knowing the answer. The tone of a teacher checking in, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、人工歯の材質研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about the material properties of artificial teeth.
lines.style: Direct and clear. A beat of pride underneath the straightforward answer. Respectful attention to the teacher, but grounded in her own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近世の耕作地分布を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered agricultural settlement patterns in the early modern period?
lines.style: Slightly more thoughtful. Gentle curiosity — this is a different kind of paper than she's commenting on. Tone stays warm but becomes more reflective.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、カトリック教会の司教職を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the history of the Catholic episcopal hierarchy.
lines.style: Steady and measured. She's clarifying her actual subject matter. No defensiveness, just precise. A quiet confidence in the distinction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧約聖書の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also addressed textual interpretation in the Old Testament?
lines.style: Engaged and genuinely interested now. Leaning in slightly. The question carries real curiosity — she's following the breadth of Sakura's interests.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、児童の起立性調節障害を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on orthostatic dysregulation in children.
lines.style: Clear and composed. She's answering what's being asked without apology. A slight pause before the answer shows she's tracking the pattern of questions, not just responding.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 専門家の見識形成を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored how experts form their professional judgment?
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Softer pacing. The teacher is drawing out the thread of what connects these papers. Genuine intellectual interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、人身売買防止策を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about strategies to prevent human trafficking.
lines.style: Direct and grounded. This answer carries weight. She states it clearly without performance. A small, intentional pause at the end — the closing of the conversation.
